title: Secret Killer Leads Cops Into Her $3,000,000 Murder Mansion

beats.description: Cold open: officer reacts to decomposition odor, narrator teases elaborate cover-up and hidden body
Introduction to Craig Thatford, his wife Dena, their lifestyle, and the first welfare check call from friend Larry
Second welfare check from grandson Cody, timeline extends to 4 months, neighbor interviews reveal inconsistencies
Phone call with Dena who claims Craig is in Mexico; ex-husbands and daughter describe Dena's violent history and threats
Financial motive emerges: Dena spent hundreds of thousands; Deputy Roger interviews Dena at home, she shows note and safe
Neighbor reveals Craig said Dena has safe combination; neighbor draws parallel to previous murder case
Second visit: Dena digging hole, makes incriminating statement; Dena vanishes, suicide rumors surface
Tip from ex-coworker: Dena admitted shooting Craig; search warrant obtained
Search of property: bleach, disabled cameras, blood traces; safe opened shows missing money; body found under carport
Daughter Leslie reveals Dena confessed: Craig pushed her, she shot him, body moved with tractor
Body positively identified as Craig; Dena found at hospital, arrested without incident
Dena invokes right to lawyer; charged with first-degree murder; case in pre-trial phase as of March 2026
